title: Echo
subtitle: Feedback to product action for Creative Studio · Proposed pilot / not deployed
thesis: Agents assemble the evidence, draft the brief and draft every update; people make the three decisions that spend capacity or credibility: commit, verify, send.

bypass.note: Restricted or unattributed: no agent run

panels.title: Audit / operating record
body: Append-only in effect: the ClickUp activity log records every field, status, agent and human action, attributed and timed.
Per issue, three durable fields: decision log, verification log, send log (recipient, destination, text, result, remote link).
Nothing happens off the task. Repeat tests run through Research Resi with human-approved plans and land back here as signals.

panels.title: Trust & eval loop
body: Pilot ceiling is L1 for every category: agents draft, people approve per item.
The decision-maker marks each draft accepted / edited / rejected; the edit rate tunes prompts.
Any agent write without an approval record disables the agent. Decisions stay L0 for good.

feedback.label: edit rate tunes the prompt, never autonomy

caption: Design choice: three agent runs per issue (prepare, decision update, outcome update), each fired once by a status change. Native agents do not guarantee call counts; runs are counted in the activity log.

The agent never decides, never creates a delivery task, never marks verified, and never posts without an approval record; restricted or unattributed items never reach it. Proposed pilot / not deployed.
